title: Legacy studies
note: Additive. Derived from louiscalata.myportfolio.com/mobile-uiux (Mendacity, Plague, Brawler, Contrails 2.0). Monochrome by default. Does not modify F01–F17.

options.name: Mendacity Void Cue
options.mechanism: Near-empty black stage; one focal actor; a single hard directional mark (arrow/plate) carries wayfinding. No ornamental chrome.
options.job: Focus attention when the system is waiting or the user must move once
options.app: Empty / loading / 'next step' gate (pairs with F10)
options.narrow: Cue becomes a 44px bottom plate; stage crops, never letterboxes with dead side gutters that scroll
options.tradeoff: Too little chrome can hide system status; pair with a one-line status strip
options.curation_rationale: Keeps Mendacity's strongest idea — extreme negative space + one directional cue — inside Jaryo mono grammar.

improved: Replaced mixed atmospheric art with machine-plate mono
Made the directional cue a first-class control (≥44px on narrow)
Added explicit pairing with a status strip so emptiness ≠ silence
Dark/light via lab theme tokens; reduced-motion: no particle reliance

options.name: Mendacity Combat Ledger
options.mechanism: Portrait disc + mono ledger rows (HP/MP or RUN/OK) + weapon/key legend as a hatched plate. Serif mix removed; hierarchy by weight and caps only.
options.job: Read vitals and bindings at a glance during a live session
options.narrow: Portrait 40px; ledger stacks under it; legend collapses behind a [KEYS] disclosure (≥44px)
options.tradeoff: Portrait costs width on 260px; disclosure hides bindings until opened
options.curation_rationale: Modernizes Mendacity's portrait+percentage HUD into a Jaryo mono ledger with adaptive disclosure.

improved: Unified type to mono ledger (no mixed serif/sans)
Percent rows become aligned tokens
Control legend is disclosed on narrow instead of floating raw text
Contrast locked to lab light/dark tokens

options.name: Plague Journal Overlay
options.mechanism: Pause/settings as a two-pane plate (nav list | detail) with ribbon-like tab chips. Quest/objective persists as a top chip outside the plate.
options.job: Interrupt work without losing place; keep the active objective visible
options.app: Run pause / Nisi journal review overlay
options.narrow: Panes stack; tabs become a 2×2 segmented control; quest chip sticky under header
options.tradeoff: Diegetic 'book' metaphor dropped — less charm, more scan speed
options.curation_rationale: Keeps Plague's journal IA and persistent quest chip; drops parchment ornament for factory plates.

improved: Replaced parchment/pink book with mono plates and tab chips
Quest tracker stays color-independent (prefix glyph + word)
Touch targets ≥44px; works 260→1280
Ornate gothic frame removed for hairline rules

options.name: Plague Dialogue Advance
options.mechanism: Speaker portrait + NAME plate + body line + explicit advance control with Idle/Hover/Pressed as outline → thick outline → inverted fill (no yellow-only signal).
options.job: Advance narrative or step logs without ambiguity
options.narrow: Portrait inline left; advance is a full-width 44px bar
options.tradeoff: Portrait optional; without it the name plate must carry identity alone
preview_ascii: | holy bird, the bird is the word |
options.curation_rationale: Preserves Plague's dialogue anatomy and three-state advance control using color-independent signals.

improved: Hover/pressed no longer rely on yellow glow alone
Advance control meets 44px; keyboard activatable
Gold ornate frame → 2px mono rule
Dark mode + reduced-motion static pressed state

options.name: Brawler Focus Stack
options.mechanism: Vertical pause/menu stack. Focused item = solid inverted fill; idle = outline only. Size hierarchy kept; neon glow removed.
options.job: Choose one primary action under interruption
options.narrow: Full-width rows 48px; outline thickness stays ≥2px for AA
options.tradeoff: Loses synthwave energy; gains AA and reduced-motion safety
options.curation_rationale: Brawler's strongest grammar was outline-vs-fill focus — kept, neon discarded.

improved: Neon pink glow → inverted mono fill for focus
Hover-scale removed under reduced motion
Contrast AA in light and dark
44px rows on narrow; cityscape photo not required

options.name: Brawler Character Rail
options.mechanism: Horizontal chooser: ◂ avatar ▸ with nameplate and P1/P2 markers as bracket tags, not colored triangles alone.
options.narrow: One avatar visible; swipe or buttons ≥44px; name truncates with full value on focus
options.tradeoff: Multi-avatar preview deferred to wide widths
options.curation_rationale: Keeps Brawler's character carousel; replaces neon ring with mono disc + bracket player tags.

improved: P1/P2 no longer color-only (bracket tags + glyph)
Chevron hit areas ≥44px
Works at 260px with single-avatar rail
Mono default; optional color left to F17/F19

options.name: Contrails Tactical Select
options.mechanism: Carousel subject in a double-ruled frame; mono segmented meters; firmware/id plate; (B) Back affordance. Grain becomes subtle hatch, not noise mush.
options.job: Compare one tactical subject with readable stats
options.app: Model or machine selector with meters
options.narrow: Meters stack; carousel arrows dock under frame at 44px
options.curation_rationale: Contrails was already near Jaryo; this locks it to factory mono + adaptive meters.

improved: Chartreuse accent → black/white segments
Signal noise → controlled hatch token
Touch/keyboard carousel; 260–1280 layout
Segmented bars expose values to AT as text, not color alone

options.name: Contrails Status Diamonds
options.mechanism: Diamond/circle icon grammar for help, mute, ok, blocked, locked. Color optional; every state has shape + word + border style.
options.job: Status and toolbar actions that survive mono and color-blind modes
options.narrow: Icons 44px; labels appear as tooltips/SR text, visible text on focus
options.tradeoff: Diamond packing is wider than circle-only toolbars
options.curation_rationale: Promotes Contrails HUD icon sheet into Jaryo's color-independent status language.

improved: Green/red outlines no longer sole signal
Each state has glyph + word + border
AA in light/dark; forced-colors friendly
44px targets; SR names included
